content_sections.body: In lost umbrella, put finished actions in a clear order. Use time words such as yesterday, first, then, and this morning. Example: “Yesterday I left my umbrella on the bus.” The past action tells the listener what happened; the time word tells when.
content_sections.title: Notice the language

content_sections.body: Yesterday I left my umbrella on the bus. I called the bus office and collected it this morning. Ask: what detail would a friend need next? Say the key action once, then add one time or place detail.
content_sections.title: Context and meaning

content_sections.body: Choose a true or invented lost umbrella detail. Say two connected sentences: one about what happened and one about the next step. Check that the order is easy to follow.
